release_notes.en:
### What's New in ArgonMusic v3.0.5

• **Track-Switch Audio Race Fix**: Immediately silences previous audio and serializes native loading so switching songs never plays old audio with new artwork.
• **HoloDeck 3D & Pixel Break Upgrades**: Real 8x8 cover-art tile fracture transitions across Standard & Cinematic Focus modes plus auto-calibrated Android gyroscope/tilt sensors.
• **Instagram Story Studio & Live Lyrics Sync**: Share directly to Instagram Stories with synced live lyrics or custom quotes, plus 15s MP4 audio starting right from where you paused.
• **Music Video 720p/1080p HD & Smooth 60fps Fix**: Selects crisp HD H.264 streams over 360p fallbacks and removes speed-nudge/seek decoder stutter.
• **Permissions, Search & Audio Lab**: Prompts Android storage and notification permissions cleanly on launch/upgrades, expands HumSearch with history, preserves Home Widget art, and wires room convolution IR DSP.
